findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "compare_areas" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: Side-by-side statistics for several Finnish postal areas, with national benchmarks and percentiles. Accepts names or codes. Free callers are served only the FIR…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_area_report · Private data: get_area_report · Public sink: rank_areas.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_area_report · Private data: get_area_report · Public sink: rank_areas

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
